search_text: published ZDI-24-1486 ZDI-CAN-22629 G DATA Total Security Incorrect Permission Assignment Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2024-12-11 CVE-2024-6871 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-6871 7.0 AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['G DATA'] ['Total Security'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of G DATA Total Security. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of autostart tasks. The issue results from incorrect permissions set on folders. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. title: G DATA Total Security Incorrect Permission Assignment Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of G DATA Total Security. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of autostart tasks. The issue results from incorrect permissions set on folders. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.
